frequency_question: What proportion of formal union strike escalation cycles in the banking sector culminate in an actual indefinite strike within two months of the initial major escalation signal?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide bank union federation strike ballots or declared strike action timelines; excludes local, single-bank, or non-banking union disputes.
coverage_note: 6 named prominent federation-level banking strike escalation cycles; 1 resulted in actual indefinite or full-day strike within the short window, while the rest were averted through conciliation.
known_gaps: Excludes minor regional or single-state union strikes in developing banking markets.
validity_reason: Labor laws and federation bargaining structures remain stable over multi-year periods.
